body: ### Confirmed funnel reset on rematch (Medium Severity). `markUnfundedDepositFunnel` always writes `confirmedAt: null`, so a second unfunded Add funds click after a deposit has already confirmed wipes the joinable funnel. The available-to-trade CTA can stay enabled until the live balance stream catches up, and that rematch makes `consumeUnfundedDepositFunnel` miss `trade_submitted_after_deposit` on the actual first order.
action: markUnfundedDepositFunnel now preserves an existing same-address confirmation; a different address still restarts the funnel.
